requiredBeforeFiling.whatWasWrong: Six real blanks -- petition.CurrentOrderCB1/CB2 (item i, CURRENT restitution/protection/restraining/no-contact order, Yes and No), petition.PriorOrderCB1/CB2 (item i, PRIOR such order, Yes and No) and petition.ExpungementCB1/CB2 (item m, prior expungement, Yes and No) -- appeared in NEITHER the guide's 'items you must supply' table NOR its 'Things the platform deliberately left blank' list, while the committed track registry declares protectiveOrders and priorExpungementGranted as REQUIRED participant intake questions. Reproduced exactly: 19 of the map's 66 canonicalRefusals had no occurrence of their own printedLabel anywhere in participant-instructions.md, and the six elections were the only ones not covered by any group sentence either.
requiredBeforeFiling.whichKindOfProblemThisIs: A MISSING PARTICIPANT INPUT that was not disclosed -- not a renderer defect and not an unresolved legal question. The build holds five neutral facts for each fixture (name, county, street, city/state/zip, phone) and no answer to either intake question, so it cannot tick a sworn box; leaving the election to the participant is right. The defect was purely that the packet never said so.
requiredBeforeFiling.theThirdThing: The record's own required-before-filing list, printed word for word, tells the participant to check an answer 'and correct the packet if they disagree' -- on item i among others. The packet makes no election on item i or item m, so there was nothing there to correct and the instruction read as though there were. The record's words are not altered: a separately headed paragraph now follows the verbatim list, marked as the packet describing its own state and not the record's, saying that the packet writes 6 values and nothing else, that every other answer is the participant's to write, and that on item i and item m what those items ask is to MAKE the election rather than correct one.
requiredBeforeFiling.howItWasFixed: The disclosure is now DERIVED from the field map instead of asserted by hand. leftBlankDisclosures() walks every canonicalRefusal, assigns it a named group, and the guide renders a generated table -- 19 rows in four groups, each row carrying the blank's own printed label, its page, the map's recorded reason and what the participant does. SPEC.deliberatelyBlank kept its six hand-written summary bullets and gained a seventh naming the three elections, so the summary is no longer misleading on its own.
requiredBeforeFiling.theGateThatMakesItStick: runFamily now REFUSES TO WRITE A BYTE unless every canonicalRefusal's own printedLabel occurs in the finished guide (stopClass REFUSED_BLANK_NOT_DISCLOSED_IN_THE_GUIDE), and stops separately if any refusal is of a kind this builder has no disclosure wording for (stopClass REFUSED_BLANK_THIS_BUILDER_CANNOT_DESCRIBE). This is the Kentucky shape generalised: a builder that must prove it disclosed every blank it refused cannot leave one undisclosed.
requiredBeforeFiling.bothGatesTestedByBreakingThem: Removing the sworn-election group from LEFT_BLANK_GROUP_ORDER produced STOPPED / REFUSED_BLANK_NOT_DISCLOSED_IN_THE_GUIDE naming exactly the six boxes VF01 named, with overlayDirectory untouched. Emptying VIEWER_CONTROL_FIELDS produced STOPPED / REFUSED_BLANK_THIS_BUILDER_CANNOT_DESCRIBE naming petition.ResetButton and petition.PrintForm. Both gates run before the output directory is created, so a stop leaves the family byte-for-byte unchanged. The builder was restored from a copy and rebuilt after each test.
requiredBeforeFiling.whatWasNotDone: No box was ticked, no election was made, no intake answer was invented, and no field became newly writable. The nine counters were not obtained by making anything unwritable.

artifacts.howItIsFixedInTheBuilder: measureFlattenedWidgets() reopens the SAVED packet after it is written and hashed, and publishes flattenedWidgetAppearancesReadFromOutputBytes plus a new sibling flattenedWidgetAppearancesCarryingTextReadFromOutputBytes and a flattenedWidgetMeasurement block naming the method, the repo-relative file it read and the count of non-FlatWidget placements. Feeding it the raw 70 would have let a packet that wrote nothing at all read as visible, because 64 of the 70 appearances are the form's own empty fields and draw no characters. The sum now uses the carrying-text subset, which is measured at 6 -- exactly the six values the map declares.
